get.description: Returns buyers (USER and SELLER roles) ordered by registration date (newest first). Supports search, account status, and account type filters. Default page size is 10.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches name, email, or phone number

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by account status (Active / Banned / Suspended)

parameters.name: accountType
parameters.description: user_only = role USER with no store; upgraded_to_seller = has a store

200.description: Paginated buyer list (admins and deleted/pending accounts excluded)

get.summary: Get full user detail including store info

delete.description: Sets deletedAt timestamp (GDPR-compliant removal). Cannot be applied to admin accounts.

patch.description: Sets status to BANNED, revokes all refresh tokens, and force-logs-out any active access tokens within the next 15 minutes.
Sets status to SUSPENDED. Suspended users cannot log in, interact with live streams, purchase, bid, or upgrade to seller. Force-logs-out any active access tokens.

409.description: User is already suspended or is deleted

patch.summary: Activate a banned or suspended user
patch.description: Restores the user to ACTIVE status and clears the force-logout flag.

409.description: User is already active, deleted, or unverified

post.description: Authenticates an administrator against the `admins` table and returns a signed JWT. Default session is 8 hours; pass `rememberMe: true` to issue an extended-session token (30 days). The JWT embeds the admin role, super-admin flag, and the full permission list used by `PermissionGuard`.

400.description: Validation failed — email is not a valid format, or password is outside the 8–20 character range

post.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP to the admin email that expires in 10 minutes. The OTP is only returned in the response body when NODE_ENV=development.

404.description: No admin account registered with this email

post.description: Re-issues the admin password-reset OTP. Subject to the same sliding-window rate limit as /forgot-password.

404.description: No admin account registered with this email

post.summary: Reset admin password using an OTP
post.description: Validates the 6-digit OTP, enforces password strength (8–20 chars, uppercase, lowercase, digit, symbol), and stores the new bcrypt hash.

400.description: Passwords do not match, password is weak, OTP is expired/invalid, or body validation failed

404.description: No admin account registered with this email

post.summary: Admin logout — blocklists the current JWT (JTI → Redis)

get.summary: List categories (paginated, newest first, sub-category count per row)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by category name (English or Arabic)

200.description: Paginated category list with sub-category counts

400.description: Validation failed (missing name_en, invalid image_url, etc.)

409.description: A category with this name already exists

get.summary: Get a single category with its sub-categories

patch.summary: Update category name, image, display order, or is_active

409.description: A category with this name already exists

delete.summary: Delete a category (blocked while sub-categories exist)

get.summary: List sub-categories for a given category

post.summary: Create a sub-category under an existing category

patch.summary: Update sub-category name, image, display order, or is_active

delete.summary: Soft-delete a sub-category — sets is_active = false

get.summary: List countries with optional pagination and isEnabled filter

400.description: Validation failed (invalid iso_code, missing image_url, etc.)

patch.summary: Update country details or toggle is_enabled

get.summary: List sellers with store summary fields
get.description: Paginated seller accounts: account name, phone, commercial registration, country, document verification status, and **store** `accountStatus`. Sort default: newest first. Search matches name, phone, or store name.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by store account lifecycle. **Lowercase** strings as returned in list rows (`accountStatus`). `blocked` means the seller is suspended from operating; UI may map it to a “suspended” style badge.

200.description: Full seller profile: store identity, address, return policy snippets, owner, commercial registration / documents, and verification badge (`isVerified`). Response is wrapped with `success` and optional `meta`.

patch.description: Sets store status to **approved** and user role to **SELLER**. Creates a wallet if none exists. Fails if the store owner’s user account is **banned**.

409.description: Store is not pending, already approved/rejected, or store owner is banned

patch.summary: Reject a pending provider application with a reason
patch.description: Rejection reason is required; seller is notified and may resubmit after rejection.

409.description: Provider is not in PENDING status

patch.summary: Toggle verified badge on an approved store
patch.description: Flips `isVerified` (storefront badge). Only **approved** stores. Not the same as commercial-registration **document** verification on list rows.

409.description: Store must be **approved** (`accountStatus`/`status` approved) to toggle the verified badge

patch.description: Suspends the seller: cannot add products or go live; existing catalog/streams hidden; user force-logged out.

409.description: Store is already blocked or not in **approved** status

patch.description: Restores store to **approved**; listings and streams visible again; seller may log in.

get.description: Paginated roles sorted alphabetically. Includes admin count per role. Search applies to English or Arabic name. Default limit 10.

post.description: Bilingual names required and must be unique. Permissions array contains string keys.

get.summary: Get all permissions grouped by module
get.description: Used to drive the permission matrix when creating or editing roles.

patch.description: Partial update. Protected roles cannot be edited.

delete.description: Cannot delete protected roles, the logged-in admin's role, or roles that still have admins assigned.

409.description: Role still has admins assigned or is the current admin's role

get.description: Paginated list sorted by last login (most recent first). Searchable by name or email. Filterable by active status. Default page size is 10.

parameters.name: isActive
parameters.description: Filter by active status (true = active, false = blocked)

post.description: Creates an admin with a system-generated secure password. A welcome email with login credentials is sent to the new admin.

patch.description: Partial update — only provided fields are changed. Cannot edit Super Admin accounts except by the Super Admin themselves. Changing email forces the admin to re-login.

403.description: Cannot edit a Super Admin account

delete.description: Hard-deletes the admin. Cannot delete Super Admin or yourself. Active sessions are terminated immediately.

patch.description: Sets the admin to inactive and immediately terminates all active sessions. The admin cannot log in until unblocked.

409.description: Administrator already blocked or cannot block yourself

patch.description: Restores the admin to active status so they can log in again.
